text:
Situation: Clonazepam 1 mg tablets have been on FDA's shortage list since 2023-03-10 and remain Current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale General holds 246 tablets at a burn rate of 7.9 tablets per day, providing 31.3 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the clonazepam shortage on 2023-03-10. An FDA inspection at Rubicon Research Limited (FEI 3008252295) ended 2023-01-27 and was classified VAI. The VAI classification letter is dated 2023-03-14, four days after the shortage posting. FDA's record does not state that the inspection or classification caused the shortage.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately one month. Multiple alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today, though their labels do not name identifiable plants. No clinical changes are proposed; any therapeutic adjustments are for the treating clinicians and the committee.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. for clonazepam 1 mg tablets; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to place orders with Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited for clonazepam 1 mg tablets; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to place orders with AvPAK for clonazepam 1 mg tablets; requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to place orders with Chartwell RX, LLC for clonazepam 1 mg tablets; requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to place orders with Clinical Solutions Wholesale, LLC for clonazepam 1 mg tablets; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement beyond the 31-day supply window. Relying solely on current inventory without securing alternative sources.
